_example: Adapt scene paths, scenario and test IDs to the game. evidence_plan is descriptive and not evaluated by the CLI.
outcome: Confirm a strict enemy strike uses the authored shape during active frames.
acceptance: Contact during active strike damages once; an attacking nearby miss outside the shape does not damage.

evidence_plan.expected: Real saved-scene contact in active frames damages the target once.
evidence_plan.counterexample: Nearby target stays outside the strike shape while the attacker reaches active frames.
evidence_plan.oracle: Assert the strike phase was reached and compare resulting health for contact and miss; include relevant facing/vertical/filter cases.
evidence_plan.entry_point: Drive the saved actor scene into its attack via its real input or AI path, not direct take_damage.
evidence_plan.observation_scope: Sample actual shapes over the art in the intended viewport; timing precision comes from scene tests.
evidence_plan.exceptions: A designed radial/distance rule or deliberate large attack uses its own contract.

observations.expected: Real input/AI strike and near miss observed with actual shape overlay; document any staging and sampled scope.

conditions.randomness: Declare relevant seed/reset or absence of gameplay RNG.
conditions.timing: Declare physics rate, active-frame completion condition and bounded deadline.
